gaps.lead: We expect to announce the winner tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: We expect to announce X → X is expected to be announced.

gaps.lead: There were fewer people at the concert than expected.
gaps.sentence: There weren't ___ at the concert as expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (people) as expected.

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.

gaps.lead: The committee is unlikely to change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ that the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal it: It is unlikely that…

gaps.sentence: The lifeguard told the children ___ near the pool.

gaps.lead: As soon as the results were announced, people started celebrating.
